decision: Do not freeze candidate v2, do not activate confirmation, and do not spend confirmatory alpha.
limitations: This bounded development screen is not a confirmatory effect estimate or significance test.
Run 006 has a valid physical record but no valid paired language measurement because its question identity differed from the declaration.
The no-odometry variant's Luna labels are retained but excluded because the judge reference omitted a supported attempt count.
Five valid paired clusters are insufficient to rescue a candidate that failed the predeclared material-error and net-advantage gates.
